While he is blessed with like-minded friends, worthy rivals, and dependable mentors, he also faces many formidable figures—such as arrogant nobles who abuse their status, and a suspicious second prince of the kingdom hiding something beneath the surface. Academy life turns out to be far more chaotic and eventful than he ever imagined!
